### Council & County
**Mayor and deputy mayor candidates talk transportation: CollingwoodToday**
The Collingwood Chamber of Commerce organized an all-candidates meeting at the Collingwood legion on Sept. 30. Mayor and deputy mayor candidates talked transportation. Jon Hillis, Yvonne Hamlin, Chris Potts, Norman Sandberg, Kathy Jeffery and Deb Doherty attended. CollingwoodToday also reports that 19 people are running for seven Collingwood council seats in the fall municipal election.

### Both Sides: Wasaga Beachwood Road housing
Wasaga Beach council approved amendments for a housing project on Beachwood Road after reassurance that flooding issues will be resolved. Simcoe.com reports the project is for 214 units. The developer will give land to the town for a channel to mitigate flooding. Staff found the project consistent with planning policies.
